sanskrit: premāṃ mātrāṃ mimīmahe yathāparaṃ na māsātai | śate śaratsu no purā ||
english: We measure out this measure forward so that none may exceed it; before a hundred autumns are ours.

sanskrit: ud imām (…) ||
english: Lift this one up […].

sanskrit: apemam (…) ||
english: Away from this one […].

sanskrit: nir imāṃ mātrāṃ mimīmahe yathā (…) ||
english: We measure out this measure outward so that […].

sanskrit: amāsi mātrāṃ svar agām āyuṣmān bhūyāsam | yathāparaṃ na māsātai | śate śaratsu no purā ||
english: The measure has been measured; I have gone to the heavenly light; may I be full of life — so that none may exceed it — before a hundred autumns are ours.

sanskrit: prāṇo apāna uta vā vyāna āyuś cakṣur dṛśe sūryāya | aparipareṇa pathā yamarājñaḥ pitṝn gaccha ||
english: In-breath and out-breath and the diffused breath, life-force, sight for seeing the sun — go by the unobstructed path of King Yama to the fathers.

sanskrit: ye naḥ pituḥ pitaro ye pitāmahā ya āviviśur urv antarikṣam | ya ākṣīyanti pṛthivīm uta dyāṃ tebhyaḥ pitṛbhyo namasā vidhema ||
english: Those who are fathers of our father, those who are grandfathers, who have entered the vast mid-air, who dwell in the earth and also in the sky — to those ancestors we render homage with reverence.

sanskrit: ye agravaḥ śaśamānāḥ pareṣu hitvā dveṣāṃsy anapatyavantaḥ | te dyām udityāvidanta lokaṃ nākasa pṛṣṭhe adi dīdhyānāḥ ||
english: Those who were foremost, striving hard, who in the beyond have left behind all hatreds and are without offspring — they, ascending to the sky, found a realm, shining on the back of the vault of heaven.

sanskrit: udanvatī dyaur avamā pīlūmatīti madhyamā | tṛtīyā ha pradyaur iti yasyāṃ pitara āsate ||
english: The lowest heaven is called the watery one, the middle one is called the pīlu-tree-bearing; the third is called the bright sky — that is where the fathers are seated.

sanskrit: idam id vā uttamaṃ divi paśyati sūryam | mātrā putraṃ yathā sicā- -abhy enaṃ bhūma ūrṇuhi ||
english: This very one beholds the highest sun in the sky; O Earth, cover him over as a mother covers her son with the hem of her garment.

sanskrit: idam id vā u nāparaṃ jarasīta utāparam | jāyā patim iva vāsasā- -abhy enaṃ bhūma ūrṇuhi ||
english: Not this one forward shall age, nor the other; O Earth, cover him over as a wife covers her husband with her garment.

sanskrit: abhi tvorṇomi pṛthivyā mātur vastreṇa bhadrayā | jīveṣu bhadraṃ tan mayi svadhā pitṛṣv amā tava ||
english: I cover you with the auspicious garment of Mother Earth; let that blessing remain among the living, with me; your svadhā-oblation is here among the fathers.

sanskrit: agnīṣomā pathikṛtā syonaṃ devebhyo ratnaṃ dadhatur vi lokam | upa preṣyatāṃ pūṣaṇaṃ yo jahāty akto yānaiḥ pathibhis tatra gacchatu ||
english: Agni and Soma, the path-makers, have laid up a soft treasure for the gods, spreading out the realm; let Pūṣan be sent forth — he who is anointed and departs; by conveyances and paths let him go there.

sanskrit: pūṣā tvetaś cyāvayatu pra vidvān anaṣṭapaśur bhuvanasya gopāḥ | sa tvaitebhyaḥ pari dadat pitṛbhyo agnir devebhyaḥ suvidatryebhyaḥ ||
english: May Pūṣan, the knowing one, the guardian of the world whose herds are not lost, stir you onward from here; may he hand you over to these fathers, and Agni to the gods who discern well.

sanskrit: āyur viśvāyuḥ pari pātu tvā pūṣā tvā pātu prapathe purastāt | yatrāsate sukṛto yatra te yayus tatra tvā devaḥ savitā dadhātu ||
english: May universal life-force and full life-span guard you; may Pūṣan guard you at the fore of the path; where the virtuous ones sit, where they have gone — there may the god Savitṛ place you.

sanskrit: idaṃ tvā vāsaḥ prathamaṃ na āgann apaitad ūha yad ihābibhaḥ purā | iṣṭāpūrtam anu saṃ krāma vidvān yatra te gacchaṃ bahudhā tatra gaccha ||
english: This garment, the first to come to you, had gone away — think upon what you were afraid of here before; go consciously along the path of the ritual merit and the charitable works; wherever your going leads in many directions, there do you go.

sanskrit: imau yunajmi te vahnī asunītaye netavai | tābhyāṃ yamasya sādanaṃ samitiṃ copa gacchatāt ||
english: These two bearers I yoke for you, to guide the spirit onward; by them may you approach the abode of Yama and his assembly.

sanskrit: agner varma pari gobhir vyayasva saṃ prorṇuṣva pīvasā medhasā ca | net tvā dhṛṣṇur harasā jarhṛṣāṇo dadhṛg vidhakṣyan nyaṅkhayātai ||
english: Clothe yourself all round in the armor of Agni with the rays of light; cover yourself well with its fat and marrow — lest the bold one, exulting in his flame, boldly intent on burning you, scorch and shrivel you.

sanskrit: dhanur hastād ādadāno mṛtasya saha kṣatreṇa varcasā balena | atraiva tvam iha vayaṃ suvīrā viśvā mṛdho abhimatīr jayema ||
english: Taking the bow from the hand of the dead one, along with its sovereignty, its lustre, and its strength — you remain right here; we here, with brave heroes, shall conquer all combats and hostile onslaughts.

sanskrit: daṇḍaṃ hastād ādadāno mṛtasya saha śrotreṇa varcasā balena | samāgṛbhāya vasu bhūri puṣṭam arvāṅ tvam ehy abhi jīvalokam ||
english: Taking the staff from the hand of the dead one, along with its hearing, its lustre, and its strength — seize well the abundant, flourishing wealth; come back hitherward to the world of the living.

sanskrit: iyaṃ nārī patilokaṃ gṛṇānā ni padyata upa tvā martya pretam | dharmaṃ purāṇam anupālayantī tasyai prajāṃ draviṇaṃ ceha dhehi ||
english: This woman, praising the world of her husband, lies down here beside you, O mortal, O departed one, keeping the ancient law; grant to her here offspring and wealth.

sanskrit: ud īrṣvā nāry abhi jīvalokaṃ gātāsum enaṃ tam upa śeṣa ehi | hastagrābhasya dadhiṣos tavedaṃ patyur janitvam abhi saṃ babhūvitha ||
english: Rise up, O woman, to the world of the living; you lie beside this one whose life-breath has gone — come away; you have fully become the wifehood of this husband who takes your hand and holds you.

sanskrit: apaśyaṃ yuvatīṃ nīyamānāṃ jīvāṃ mṛtebhyaḥ pariṇīyamānām | andhena yat tamasā prāvṛtāsīt prākto avācīm anayaṃ tad enām ||
english: I saw a young woman being led, a living one being led around among the dead; when she was shrouded by the blind darkness, I led her away from here downward toward the east.

sanskrit: prajānaty aghnye jīvalokaṃ bhavantī devānāṃ panthām anusaṃcarantī | eṣa te gopatis taṃ juṣasva svargaṃ lokam adhi rohayainam ||
english: Knowing the world of the living, becoming whole, following the path of the gods — this is your herd-lord; cherish him; mount him up to the heavenly realm.

sanskrit: upa dyām upa vetasam avattaro nadīnām | agne pittam apām asi ||
english: Near the sky, near the reed, you are the lower one among the rivers; O Agni, you are the bile of the waters.

sanskrit: yaṃ tvam agne samadahas tam u nir vāpayā punaḥ | kiyāṃbuvatra rohatu śāṇḍadūrvā vyalkaśā ||
english: The one you, O Agni, have burned up completely — do quench him back again; let the śāṇḍa-grass, the dūrvā-grass, and the vyalkaśā plant grow on that very spot.

sanskrit: idaṃ ta ekaṃ para u ta ekaṃ tṛtīyena jyotiṣā saṃ viśasva | saṃveśane tanvaś cārur edhi priyo devānāṃ parame sadhasthe ||
english: This one part of you, and yonder that other part of you — enter together with the third light; in the union of body be beautiful, be dear to the gods in the highest abode.

sanskrit: ut tiṣṭha prehi pra drava- -okaḥ kṛṇuṣva salile sadhasthe | tatra tvaṃ pitṛbhiḥ saṃvidānaḥ saṃ somena madasva saṃ svadhābhiḥ ||
english: Rise up, go forth, run forward; make your home in the watery abode; there, reunited with the fathers, rejoice together with Soma, rejoice together with the svadhā-oblations.

sanskrit: pra cyavasva tanvaḥ saṃ bharasva mā te gātraṃ vi hāyi mo śarīram | mano niviṣṭamam anu saṃ pra viśasva yatra bhūmer juṣase tatra gaccha ||
english: Move forth from the body, gather yourself together; let not your limb be scattered, nor your body; enter again into the most deeply settled mind; where you take delight in the earth, there go.

sanskrit: varcasā māṃ pitaraḥ somyāso añjantu devā madhvā ghṛtena | cakṣuṣo mā prataraṃ tārayanto jarase mā jaradaṣṭiṃ vardhayantu ||
english: May the soma-drinking fathers anoint me with lustre; may the gods anoint me with honey and ghee; carrying me further across with my eyes, may they increase in me the long life of old age and its blessings.

sanskrit: varcasā māṃ sam anakty agnir medhāṃ me viṣṇur ny anakty āsani | rayiṃ me viśve ni yacchantu devāḥ śuddhā āpaḥ pavanair mā pūnantu ||
english: Agni anoints me all over with lustre; Viṣṇu anoints my intelligence in the mouth; may all the gods bestow wealth upon me; may the pure waters purify me with purifying streams.

sanskrit: mitrāvaruṇā pari mām adhātām ādityā mā svaravo vardhayantu | varco ma indro ny anaktu hastayor jaradaṣṭiṃ mā savitā kṛṇotu ||
english: May Mitra and Varuṇa set me about; may the Ādityas increase in me the radiance of the sun; may Indra anoint lustre upon me in my hands; may Savitṛ grant me the blessed long life of old age.
